title: Yara and the Will
author: Beatrix Brightwater
blurb: Vesper Nakamura, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
